Antipattern.description:
A single detected anti-pattern (Stage D output).

``kind`` is closed: the four shipped detectors cover cross-context
FKs, distributed transactions, view-of-views chains, and SPs that
span detected contexts. New kinds require an explicit Literal edit
+ a matching detector module so the surface stays auditable.

``affected_objects`` lists the qualified names (table / view / SP)
that participate in the anti-pattern. ``mitigation`` is a short
human-readable suggestion; the substantive mitigation discussion
lives in the narrative produced by Stage E.
Antipattern.title: Antipattern

BoundedContext.description:
A named context grouping one or more proposed services.

``lob_classification`` is the line-of-business label inherited from
the M1 LoB classifier (see ``primitives.db_schema_analyze.Table.
lob_classification``); it is free-form on purpose so consumer
schemas can carry domain-specific labels without forcing a Literal
edit per project.
BoundedContext.title: BoundedContext

OwnershipReport.description:
Per-table ownership map — Stage B output.

A table is "shared" when more than one service writes to it. The
design spec calls these out as the primary migration blockers, so
the M3 narrative leads with this section. ``owners_per_table`` is
keyed by the qualified table name (``"<schema>.<table>"``) and maps
to the writer service names; tables present in ``shared_tables``
must also appear in ``owners_per_table`` with >= 2 entries.
OwnershipReport.title: OwnershipReport

SequencingPlan.description:
Strangler-fig extraction order (Stage C output).

``extract_order`` is the ordered list of service names the sequencer
recommends extracting from the legacy monolith (lower index =
earlier). ``deferred`` is services Stage C identified as
extractable but parked behind a constraint (team capacity, a
shared-table blocker, etc.). ``never_extract`` is services Stage C
believes should stay inside the legacy monolith (very high coupling,
critical-path latency, etc.). ``rationale`` is a short paragraph
explaining the ordering — the substantive narrative lives in the
Stage E ``modernization-plan.md``.
SequencingPlan.title: SequencingPlan

Service.description:
A single proposed service within a bounded context.

``owned_tables`` and ``owned_sps`` are the M1 / M2 inventory names
Stage B's ownership analyser assigned to this service.
``dependencies`` lists peer service names this service calls or
reads from (directional). ``cohesion_score`` and ``coupling_score``
are unit-interval floats (Stage A / B computed) intended to be
sorted on — high cohesion / low coupling is the goal of the
decomposition.
Service.title: Service

description:
Top-level plan produced by the M3 pipeline.

Schema-versioned so downstream primitives (M4, C7) can refuse a
mismatched output (design spec §"File contract" rule).
``target_paradigm`` is a closed Literal — the three shipped
paradigms are the only sequencer / diagram-renderer code paths.

Gemini subset (issue #548 / SPEC §6.3 + §7.2): persisted M3 artefact,
not an LLM ``response_format`` schema. Pydantic emits ``$ref`` chains
for the nested ``BoundedContext``/``Service``/``OwnershipReport``
graph + ``additionalProperties: <schema>`` for ``OwnershipReport.
owners_per_table`` — both exceed Gemini's subset. Decorated with
``@accepts_extended_schema`` because the plan is written to disk
for downstream M4 / C7 consumption, not sent through harness
structured-output mode.
title: DecompositionPlan
